  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_EC" name="EC">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TELL_INQ</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_INQ" name="INQ">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>NOTIFY_IP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_IP" name="IP">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK_CHANGE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHANGE_POSSIBLE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CONFIRM_CHANGE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REJECT_CHANGE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_CONFIRMED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_REJECTED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Change of master data" />
    <bpmn:task id="TELL_INQ" name="Tell the INQ about the change of the master data" />
    <bpmn:task id="NOTIFY_IP" name="Notify the IP of the change" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK_CHANGE" name="Check whether the master data can be changed at the desired time" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CHANGE_POSSIBLE" name="Can the master data be changed at the desired time?" />
    <bpmn:task id="CONFIRM_CHANGE" name="Confirm the changes of the INQ" />
    <bpmn:task id="REJECT_CHANGE" name="Reject the changes of the INQ" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_CONFIRMED" name="Changes confirmed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_REJECTED" name="Changes rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="TELL_INQ" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="TELL_INQ" targetRef="NOTIFY_IP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="NOTIFY_IP" targetRef="CHECK_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="CHECK_CHANGE" targetRef="CHANGE_POSSIBLE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" name="yes" sourceRef="CHANGE_POSSIBLE" targetRef="CONFIRM_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" name="no" sourceRef="CHANGE_POSSIBLE" targetRef="REJECT_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="CONFIRM_CHANGE" targetRef="END_CONFIRMED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="REJECT_CHANGE" targetRef="END_REJECTED" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
